itens.titulo: Alckmin defende Gas Release mesmo com pressão contrária da Petrobras
itens.descricao: Alckmin defende Gas Release mesmo com pressão contrária da Petrobras Poder360
trechos: Como mostrou o Poder360, a Petrobras atua para adiar o avanço do programa, que está sob análise da ANP (Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis).
Ao solicitar o adiamento, a Petrobras apontou para possíveis incertezas depois de 2030, ano em que o programa terminaria, conforme estabelecido na minuta que está em discussão.
“Não existe negócio possível sem segurança regulatória, sem previsibilidade.
E é isso que nós garantimos no Brasil: respeito aos contratos e segurança regulatória”, disse Chambriard em painel em que participava o diretor-geral da ANP, Artur Watt.
A proposta estabelece que o 1º leilão será realizado de agosto a setembro de 2027.
De 2028 a 2030, serão feitos leilões anuais, com entrega dos volumes arrematados sempre no ano seguinte.
Em 2030, a ANP pretende realizar uma ARR (Avaliação de Resultado Regulatório) para decidir sobre a continuidade, ajuste ou encerramento do programa, baseando-se na efetividade do alcance das metas.

itens.titulo: Micron's 269% Rally Is About to Face Four Big Tests
itens.descricao: Micron's 269% Rally Is About to Face Four Big Tests Yahoo Finance
trechos: Micron Technology (MU, Financials) is entering its fiscal fourth-quarter earnings with great expectations following a roughly 270% stock rise this year.Four components of the business might make the difference between that optimism being justified or not.
The first is DRAM, Micron's largest growth engine as AI and data-center clients gobble up more memory.Sales of DRAMs rose to $31.33 billion in June from $7.07 billion in the same month a year ago.
NAND supplies the second test.The company's revenue in June increased 363.1% from a year earlier to $9.94 billion.
The third, and maybe most crucial, statistic is data-center growth.Cloud Memory sales rose to $13.77 billion in June, from $7.75 billion in March.
Core Data Center revenue increased to $11.52 billion, from $5.69 billion.
Mobile & Client revenue was $11.52 billion in June, Automotive & Embedded $4.63 billion.
Micron shares have soared 269.5% this year, giving the firm a considerably stronger position to clear when it reports Sept.
30.For investors, the earnings report is not just whether AI demand is still strong.

itens.titulo: Ethereum Price Forecast: ETH Fractal Signals 80% Breakout Setup
itens.descricao: Ethereum Price Forecast: ETH Fractal Signals 80% Breakout Setup Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: 29, ETH was trading near $2,723, testing the upper portion of a broad $2,150-$2,800 range on its two-week chart.
Previous bullish resolutions from this structure were followed by gains of roughly 65% to 135%, making the current setup notable from a fractal perspective.
In four previous instances highlighted on the chart, bullish breaks from around this region preceded advances of approximately 65.8%, 93.4%, 91.0%, and 134.7%.
ETH is now again testing the range ceiling near $2,750-$2,800.
A sustained move above the $2,750-$2,800 area may trigger a rally toward $3,963, approximately 45% above current prices.
Above $3,963, the previous record-high region near $4,850 would become the next major technical level, representing roughly 80% upside from $2,723.
ETH is trading above its 50-period EMA (red) near $2,562, 100-period EMA (purple) around $2,468, and 20-period (green) EMA near $2,371 on the two-week timeframe.
The two-week RSI is near 55, above the neutral 50 level but below overbought territory.
